description: Find the condition id for a health condition, symptom or goal. Answers when the name matches one condition clearly (data.conditions lists it first, with up to 4 related suggestions); a weak or ambiguous name (e.g. 'blood pressure': high vs low) returns needs_confirmation with the suggestions in candidates. Ask the user which one they mean and pass its id as condition to get_supplements_for_condition.
name: search_conditions
title: Find a health condition
